items.name: Howrah Cube Open 2024

venue.name: Shree Shyam Mandir Ghusuridham Sabhagar (Hall)
venue.address: 122, Jogendranath Mukherjee Rd, Ghusuri, Howrah, West Bengal - 711107

items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.
Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.**

* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.
* Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
* Addition of any New Round on spot will be done only under the discretion of the Delegate with consultation of Organising team.

**Non-Veg Food is strictly prohibited in the Venue Premises.**

items.name: Alabama Championship 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnBnIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7a09718d6054d5a655cef0d7fc5baea3b0c67969/al-champs-png.png)

Welcome to Alabama Championship 2024, the first championship in state history!

The competition is open to all, but only Alabama residents are eligible for state champion titles. See [AL Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlabamaChampionship2024#36807-al-champion-eligibility) for more info.

**You must read ALL registration requirements BEFORE registering!**

This competition is supported and [recognized](https://cubingusa.org/state_championships) by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).
